answer_1.quote: We presented FAME, a novel method for analogy making.
answer_1.outputs: FAME generates analogy mappings between domains and suggests new entities to extend analogies.

answer_2.quote: Our model's accuracy is 81.2% on simple, 2x2 problem s(guess level=50%). On larger problems, it achieves 77.8% perfect mappings (guess level=13.1%).

answer_4.quote: We compare FAME with human thinking in a 2phase experiment.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to map each B entity into exactly one T entity. In the open-world phase, participants were instructed to fill in the blank with an entity that preserves the analogy.
